verdict.rationale: Pipecat is event-driven at the code level. Turn events let developers act on user and assistant messages as they occur, interruptions automatically cancel in-flight work when the user speaks, carrier webhooks start telephony sessions, and Flows functions trigger node transitions. However, this is developer-written Python handlers, not a user-definable rules or automation engine. Missing for 10: a declarative rule/trigger configuration surface, a documented catalog of event types bindable to actions, and independent hands-on corroboration of event-triggered automation.
